How to link a sheet (one-time)
1. Open the sheet in Google Sheets and click the correct tab at the bottom (e.g. “Ext Modeling”, “Sheet2”).
2. Click Share → General access → “Anyone with the link” → Viewer. (Or File → Share → Publish to web → that tab → CSV, and paste that link instead.)
3. Copy the address bar URL (it ends with #gid=… — that picks the tab), paste it in the matching card above, click Save.
4. Click Sync All Sheets Now. The dashboard remembers the last good sync, even after refreshing the page.
